theme_and_archetype.description: Elegant, cinematic, moody, high-end photography gallery. Black and white aesthetic.

layout_and_spacing.gallery_grid: columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 xl:columns-4 gap-6 space-y-6
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment, text left-aligned, asymmetry favored in headers.

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-white/10

floating_payment_bar.classes: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center gap-6

photo_card.classes: relative group overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0A] break-inside-avoid mb-6 rounded-sm

interactions_and_motion.photo_hover: Image scales up slightly (scale-105) over 0.5s ease-out. Overlay darkens (bg-black/30) to reveal heart icon.
interactions_and_motion.heart_toggle: Scale pop (scale-110 then scale-100) on click. Changes from white outline to solid white (or solid red if preferred, but white fits the minimal theme better).
interactions_and_motion.payment_bar_entrance: Slides up from bottom (translate-y-8 to translate-y-0) and fades in (opacity-0 to opacity-100) when selection count > 0.
interactions_and_motion.button_hover: Background color shifts slightly, text color remains high contrast. Transform -translate-y-0.5.

specific_overrides.button: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm. No heavy gradients. 1px solid border for secondary buttons. Solid white bg with black text for primary (PayPal) button.
specific_overrides.dialog: Admin login modal - Glassmorphism backdrop, solid dark background for modal content, strict 1px border.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements (photos, hearts, payment button, login inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.gallery_implementation: Use pure CSS masonry (columns-1 sm:columns-2 etc.) and break-inside-avoid for photo items to prevent cutting. Do not use complex JS masonry unless strictly needed.
instructions_to_main_agent.pricing_logic: Price is 3 EUR per photo. Multiply selection count by 3. Display dynamically in the floating bar.
instructions_to_main_agent.paypal_integration: The 'Pay with PayPal' button should simply redirect via href to 'https://paypal.me/nophotopix/[TOTAL_PRICE_HERE]EUR' or similar standard format as requested by requirements.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_page: Create a simple path '/admin'. Protect with a hardcoded password check for MVP. Show a minimal file upload interface (Shadcn customized).
